tasks.label: Console: isolated dev gateway
tasks.command: env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" ENV=dev KB_UPLOAD_ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/csav2-dev/kb-uploads" OTEL_EXPORTER=console .venv/bin/python -c 'from psycopg.conninfo import conninfo_to_dict; from csa.core.settings import get_settings; import uvicorn; s=get_settings(); expected={"host":"127.0.0.1","port":"5434","dbname":"csa"}; pairs=((s.DATABASE_URL,"csa_app"),(s.IDENTITY_DATABASE_URL,"csa_identity")); valid=all(all(conninfo_to_dict(str(dsn)).get(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()) and conninfo_to_dict(str(dsn)).get("user")==role for dsn,role in pairs); valid or exit("Refusing gateway startup: isolated dev database target/role mismatch"); uvicorn.run("apps.gateway.main:app",host="127.0.0.1",port=18081)'

tasks.label: Console: isolated dev frontend
tasks.command: cd CSA_WebConsole/csa-console/web && env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="/tmp/fourstacks-toolbin:/usr/bin:/bin" NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 CSA_CONSOLE_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:18081 /tmp/fourstacks-toolbin/node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --webpack --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 13000

tasks.label: Console: isolated dev KB ingestion
tasks.command: env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" ENV=dev KB_UPLOAD_ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/csav2-dev/kb-uploads" KB_INGEST_ENABLED=true KB_INGEST_POLL_SECONDS=2 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.dev_kb_ingest --client-id 7f797233-684a-47ab-8222-6e887b6480db

tasks.label: Console: isolated dev conversation worker
tasks.command: env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" ENV=dev KB_UPLOAD_ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/csav2-dev/kb-uploads" KB_INGEST_ENABLED=true OTEL_EXPORTER=console .venv/bin/python -c 'from psycopg.conninfo import conninfo_to_dict; from csa.core.settings import get_settings; from scripts.dev_kb_ingest import validate; import asyncio; s=get_settings(); validate(s); expected={"host":"127.0.0.1","port":"5434","dbname":"csa"}; pairs=((s.DATABASE_URL,"csa_app"),(s.LG_DATABASE_URL,"csa")); valid=all(all(conninfo_to_dict(str(dsn)).get(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()) and conninfo_to_dict(str(dsn)).get("user")==role for dsn,role in pairs); valid or exit("Refusing worker startup: isolated dev database target/role mismatch"); from apps.worker.main import main; asyncio.run(main())'
